outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1 bound to cadmium, used to support a quantitative comparison across proteins/metals in Fig. 5C. Neither the panel nor the caption states how many times the measurement/experiment was repeated or what kind of replicate (biological, technical) this represents, so it is impossible to judge reproducibility of the result.
Panel B shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5 with cadmium. As with panel A, no information is given on the number or type of replicate measurements underlying this spectrum.

Panel C presents proportions of PacL1/PacL1Δ5/PacL2 bound to 0–3 Cd atoms, quantified from native MS peak intensities. No error bars are shown and the caption does not state whether these values derive from a single spectrum/experiment or an average of several independent measurements, nor how many.
Panel D shows metal-bound fractions for zinc across the same proteins, with the same lack of any statement on number or type of replicate experiments.
Panel E shows copper-bound fractions; no replicate number or type is given in the caption.
Panel F shows manganese-bound fractions; as with the other native MS quantification panels (C–E), no information on the number or type of replicate measurements is provided.
